reproduction.frozen_detector_policy: Frozen James thresholds are applied unchanged. Fresh-panel results are retrospective diagnostics, not threshold fitting or prospective validation.

model_risk_review.interpretation: The frozen constrained fit is finite, positive, and numerically stable, but its token measurement variance is vastly larger than its process variance. The scalar Kalman update therefore gives the xStock token observation very little weight; this is a weak-challenger limitation, not evidence that the filter is unstable. Fresh diagnostic-period MAE/RMSE are worse than raw xStock, so do not present QQQx as a superior point estimate.

interpretation_limits: The panel includes a 24-hour five-minute grid; underlying observations are naturally concentrated in equity trading hours.
Metrics score only contemporaneous underlying-observable rows and are descriptive, retrospective diagnostics.
No tuning or recalibration was performed on this period; it is out of the frozen model training cutoff but is not a prospectively observed trial.
P1a assimilates the same xStock input being compared with its challenger; this is model-based challenger evidence, not an independent-observation test.
The original handoff training CSV bytes are unavailable; source_training_dataset_sha256 is the declared fit binding and was not independently recomputed.

X-Perp residual uncertainty is not Gaussian-calibrated by P1a-C. Only the promoted SPY frozen detector may produce CHALLENGED, and only when its frozen challenge threshold is crossed with exact-time X-Perp directional corroboration; no X-Perp-specific z-score or predictive variance is used.
